subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The SEC Whistleblower Program
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The SEC Whistleblower Program.

hook.text: Since 2011, the SEC has awarded over $1.5 billion to whistleblowers. The largest single award exceeded $279 million.

buildup.text: The SEC's whistleblower program pays individuals who report securities violations leading to successful enforcement.

discovery.text: The program received over 18,000 tips in 2023 alone. It has fundamentally changed how fraud is detected.

twist.text: Financial incentives create a tension: are whistleblowers motivated by justice or money? The SEC says it doesn't matter.

climax.text: The program works. It deters fraud, accelerates detection, and gives companies a reason to catch problems first.

punchline.text: $1.5 billion awarded. 18,000 tips yearly. The program works.

quiz.question: How much has the SEC awarded to whistleblowers since 2011?
